I never asked for your respect. Nameless, faceless troll person who's in a troll farm in China.
The seed oils thing is really funny. I get smacked for that all the time. You know, I was curious
about the issue because so many people are talking about seed oils being bad. They've done
multiple studies where they take people who eat a lot of saturated fats, which are totally fine,
by the way, but they replace some fraction of those with seed oils. And in almost every study,
the people are months later healthier. And so like the idea that seed oils are bad for you
is usually concluded by folks that are like a really deep into lipidology research and they're
inferring that seed oil should be bad for you based on various cooking process modifications.
But inference is dope and I use it all the time in decision making, but it never beats actual
empirical randomized control trials because that's like what the real world actually is. It's like,
well, I think Stacy likes me. Go ask her. She's like, no, you're like, okay, I was wrong.
